items.title: Acutaas completes electrolyte-additive plant trials, starts commercial supplies; lifts FY27 guidance
items.text: Acutaas Chemicals said it completed trial runs at its electrolyte additive battery-chemicals plant and has begun commercial supplies, aiming for full capacity over the medium term. Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 42.7% YoY to Rs 4,369 mn, EBITDA rose 84.6% to Rs 1,760 mn (40.3% margin) and PAT rose 71.4% to Rs 1,231 mn; FY27 revenue growth guidance was raised from 25% to about 30%, with EBITDA margin guidance of 38-40%. The sources do not break out additive revenue, so group results remain CDMO-led, but commercial supply is a first step towards domestic electrolyte additive supply.
